name: log-analyzer
description: Streaming log analysis for files, directories, globs, gzip rotations and live docker/compose/kubectl/journald sources: auto-detected formats (Java, Node, Python, Go, .NET, Rails, nginx/Apache, syslog, logfmt, JSON, docker/CRI, Heroku, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry), multiline exceptions, LogQL-lite queries, error fingerprints with baselines, Drain templates, trace timelines, access-log latency percentiles, and rotation-safe watching with alert rules

envVars.name: LOG_EXPORT_DIR
envVars.description: Directory that report and error-baseline output must stay inside (also the default report location). Unset allows any absolute path.

envVars.name: LOG_ALLOWED_ROOTS
envVars.description: Optional list of directories (OS path-delimiter separated) that log paths must resolve inside, after symlinks. Unset allows any absolute path.

envVars.name: LOG_REDACT
envVars.description: Set to false to stop masking secrets (URL credentials, bearer tokens, password/api_key values) in tool output. Default: redaction on.
